FTutor1.synopsis: Darci's first day at the Combat Centre. Text instructions walk her through punches and kicks, the grapple, sprinting, the sliding tackle, triple combos, knocking a target down and arresting it, and finally fighting four at once with back and side kicks. The targets are training dummies dressed as Wildcats.
characters: Training dummies (Wildcat grey), who go down only to the move each lesson teaches

Assault1.synopsis: Officer Dean puts Darci through her physical on the assault course: stick to the track, grab the zip cable, and hit the switch at the end before the two-minute clock runs out. Attacking Dean ends the test.

testdrive1a.synopsis: Three laps of the oval in a squad car inside 90 seconds, avoiding cones and oil drums. The instructor starts the watch when Darci gets in. Running over the instructor, the other cops or the contractors fixing the station heating ends it.

fight1.synopsis: Combat Silver: waves of skilled and sometimes armed sparring partners, each wave against the clock. Clearing the first stage gives the Bronze grade on the way.
characters: Sparring partners in Wildcat colours: guards, Man In Black fighters and one who runs

testdrive2.synopsis: Two laps of the intermediate course in 120 seconds, with a reverse park into a marked bay on each lap. Hurting or arresting the training officer ends it.
characters: A second cop by the track

fight2.synopsis: Combat Gold: harder waves, tighter clock, and assassins among the sparring partners.
characters: Sparring partners in Wildcat colours: guards, Man In Black fighters and assassins

testdrive3.synopsis: The advanced course in a meat wagon: two laps in 140 seconds, with two reverse parks per lap.

police1.synopsis: Darci's first beat as a rookie in West District. Despatch sends her to an abandoned taxi after a crash on Zarb Avenue, where two cops are dealing with the drunk who caused it; she drives the taxi back to the station's vehicle drop. On the way an attempted homicide comes in from the Clunton Projects: the victim's friend points her to Kleetus Avenue, where three witnesses argue about how many shots they heard. A mugging crew works the area, and she must bring at least one mugger in alive; one waits on a rooftop. An old tramp hails her by name: Deeks, her late father's snitch from his cop days, who promises to help her. Side jobs: arrest the extra muggers, a man urinating in the park, and a lecherous civilian; talk to Deeks.
characters: **Darci Stern**: rookie, first day on the beat
**Deeks**: tramp, forty years on Union City's streets, Darci's father's old snitch
**The witness**: the homicide victim's friend; she mustn't be harmed
**Three muggers**: Wildcats, one on a rooftop with a gun
**O'Doole** and other cops at the station; streetwalkers in the cells
Bystanders arguing over two, three or four shots

police2.synopsis: A jumper is on a ledge of Brooks Tower on Keating Avenue. He's Barnaby, depressed because the Union City Fire Department turned him down, and he jumps if anyone approaches him head-on. Darci climbs the next building and rides the zip line down behind him, then talks him off: he decides he'd rather be a cop. Along the way: officer Miles' squad car has been stolen (a streetwalker saw a 'slick dude' on Lime Street, a Wildcat car thief), and a crazed woman in the park turns out to be 'Crack Suckin' Susan'. A wounded woman lies at a shooting where a punk screamed 'Union City will fall!', the first sign of the Wildcats' war on the city.
characters: **Barnaby**: the jumper, wants to be a fireman, then a cop
**Old cop at the tower**: retiring next month
Onlookers betting on blood; three women in a developer joke ('Mucky test')

Bankbomb1.synopsis: The first mission on the other side of the law: Mako, a Wildcat heavy brought in from outside, is told by the Boss's man to cause CHAOS. He drives a car bomb to the bank courtyard and runs before it blows, then takes a second car bomb (the Boss's explosives expert's work) to a department store guarded by a police bomb squad. Cliffy and Zit, two Wildcats touchy about their nicknames, back him up and take on the cops. Losing either of them, or wrecking a car bomb before it's delivered, fails it.
characters: Cops who jump Cliffy and Zit at the end (guilty)
